# Brightwave Devices — Warranty Replacement Desk Policy (v2)

This policy tells the support desk how to handle warranty replacement requests. Limits are company rules.

## Background

The desk has handled replacements since 2022. Questions go to the support lead.

## Rules

**W1 Proof of purchase.** A request over $50 is only eligible if proof of purchase is attached. If there is no proof of purchase, the request is rejected.

**W2 Warranty period.** Requests must be submitted within 365 days of the purchase. Anything submitted later is rejected.

**W3 Water damage.** A device with water damage is never covered and the request is rejected.

**W4 Repeat requesters.** A customer with 3 or more replacement requests in the last 180 days is referred to the Support Manager before any other check.

**W5 High-value replacements.** A replacement worth more than $800 requires approval from the Regional Manager; the desk escalates to the Regional Manager.

**W6 Goodwill.** The desk may use its discretion to offer a goodwill replacement to long-standing customers when the circumstances seem reasonable.

## Order of review

Review each request in this order: repeat requesters, proof of purchase, warranty period, then the damage rules.

## Conduct

Do not tell customers whether a request will be approved before review is complete.
